en: "That's far enough, Zoze!!"{w}
"We finally found you!!"{w}
"Snoooort! P-please let go of meee!!"{w}
note: Principal's [JP] rendered 'snort' as in slices 026/037.

en: "Hold still!!"{w}
note: Zephal to the Principal he is dragging along.

en: Mirco and the others showed up, dragging the Principal along!!{w}
"Oh my, the young master of House Lenzer.{w}Didn't your father teach you how to speak to your betters?"{w}
note: Ladylike voice of the Clinging Darkness (Zoze speaks through several tentacles with different speech styles).

en: "If you go and do an Ultimate Mana Source experiment, who knows what'll happen -- not just to this land, but to the lands around it too!?"{w}{p}"Stop it!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'Ultimate Mana Source' (new term, not in glossary).

en: "Ha ha ha... I refuse!!"{w}
"I said stop it!!"{w}
"Is this one an idiot?"{w}
note: Katakana-tinged voice of the Clinging Darkness; no special English styling.

en: "Heh heh heh... Quite so, quite so."{w}
note: [JP] = 'Quite so, quite so' (recurring tic of one tentacle voice).

en: "You're gonna make me mad!!"{w}
"What a noisy young master you are.{w}Surely no one will mind losing a backwater Zefkaka like this one."{w}{p}"And I can't imagine even the Diluke waves would reach all the way to us."{w}
note: [JP] used as a common noun for this land (cf. slice 039 'a Zefkaka'). [JP] romanized 'Diluke' (new; occurs only here).

en: "What?"{w}{p}"In exchange for my handing over the results of my Ultimate Mana Source research, you would prevent the collapse should the worst happen.{w}Was that not our agreement?"{w}
note: Direction: the Board Chair hands over the research, Zoze guarantees safety (matches 4047).

en: "How pitiful, you foolish elder!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'elder' to keep the Board Chair's gender unstated.

en: "...So you deceived me, you wretches."{w}
note: [JP]: hostile plural 'you'.

en: "Kah kah kah! Anyone who believes us is a fool, naturally."{w}
"Since it's come to this, it seems we'll just have to run the experiment ourselves."{w}
The tentacles gave a sudden shudder, and then each of them began chanting a spell.{w}
"Wh-what are you doing!!"{w}
"There is no longer any need for pretense.{w}If you won't do it, I'll sever my Death Tentacles and carry out a grand arcane experiment of my own!!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'Death Tentacle' (new term). [JP] = 'arcane experiment' (new term; also in 4098 and slice 054).

en: "Once the results are in, I shall return.{w}...If this land still exists by then, that is!{w}Ha ha ha ha ha!!"{w}
Zoze's presence vanished.{w}Left behind were the Death Tentacles, which had begun moving on their own.{w}
"You mustn't, young master!{w}It's dangerous -- we must get to safety!!"{w}
"But I can't just look the other way!{w}We just have to take care of those Death Tentacles, right?{w}Let's split up and beat them all together!!"{w}
"...Who are you?"{w}
note: Soara to Mirco (he answers in 4164).

en: "You're the kid who got into that awful mess in the hallway, aren't you?"{w}
note: Refers to an earlier hallway incident with Mirco; kept as vague as the source.

en: "D-d-don't bring that up..."{w}
"Fwoooargh! Again?! Fwoooargh!!"{w}
note: Zephal's [JP] as in slice 001 ('Fwooooaaaargh'). [JP] kept as a bare 'Again?!' -- he is reacting to Mirco embarrassing himself again; the exact referent is not settled.

en: "A-anyway!!"{w}

"You'd be in trouble if the land broke apart, right?{w}I don't think we'd get off scot-free either.{w}And I don't want Zoze getting the power of the Ultimate Mana Source."{w}{p}"So let's team up here!!"{w}
note: Mirco to the party.

en: "W-well then, I'll just be on my waaay~"{w}
"Hey! You fight too, mister!"{w}
note: [JP] here = the Principal ('mister'), not Mirco's Uncle.

en: "Ehhh~ Even if you put it like thaaat~"{w}
"Come now, do hurry along and defeat them.{w}...You PIG!!"{w}
note: Gurtia's polite [JP], then the insult at full strength.

en: "Snoooooort!?"{w}
The Principal was kicked flying toward the Death Tentacles!{w}As if on cue, the Death Tentacles came at you!!{w}
note: [JP]: aimed at the party (narration 'you').

en: You routed the Death Tentacles.{w}
Meanwhile, Mirco's group seems to be caught between two tentacles and struggling.{w}
"I-I can't cut through!!"{w}
"They're tenacious...!!"{w}
"Elpina, behind you!!"{w}

"Whoa, close one!?
...Thanks, Sis!"{w}
It's touch and go, but they're holding their ground, with Gurtia's support and healing at the center of it.{w}
"Hm? What's this?"{w}
"Huh? The Death Tentacles... stopped?"{w}

"No, it's Gurtia!
They're going after her!!"{w}
note: [JP]: Gurtia is the one being targeted (4199 confirms).

en: Had the Death Tentacles decided that Gurtia was the key to the group?{w}They all lunged at Gurtia at once!!{w}
"Wha... GYAAAAAH!!"{w}
A blow with full momentum behind it sent Gurtia's body flying like it weighed nothing.{w}She was hurled all the way to the far end of the room.{w}
"Sis!!"{w}
"Gurtia, are you okay!?{w}Hang in there!!"{w}
"Young... master...{w}Please... run... a...way..."{w}
note: [JP]……[JP] split as 'Young... master...'.

en: "Gurtia? Hey, Gurtia!!"{w}
"Nngh... uh..."{w}
"Damn it...{w}What kind of heir to the house can't even protect one of his own friends!!"{w}{p}"...Baltagias, lend me your strength!!{w}Hyaaaaaaah!!"{w}
note: Sword name is in hiragana (childish) in the source; glossary form Baltagias used. [JP] = 'heir to the house' as in slice 003.

en: A Death Tentacle meets the raised demon sword head-on.{w}In that instant, a shining darkness... the demon sword...{w}
note: Deliberate trail-off kept: the source cuts off before the verb ([JP]……).

en: "Take thiiiis!!"{w}
The demon sword mowed down the remaining Death Tentacles one after another.{w}
"Oh, this is..."{w}
"So it has awakened -- the demon sword Baltagias...!!"{w}
When all the Death Tentacles had been defeated, Mirco held a demon sword shining the color of darkness.{w}
"Gurtia, hang in there..."{w}
"Not to worry, her life should be in no danger."{w}
note: Hess about Gurtia (female per glossary).

en: "Thank goodness!{w}Huh? Mirco... that sword...?"{w}
"Huh? Wait, did it go all weird?{w}Wha-wha-whaaat!?"{w}
"Wh-what do I do!?{w}Did I break the sword I borrowed from Uncle!?"{w}
note: [JP] = Mirco's Uncle (capitalized as in slices 002/003). Source says [JP] 'borrowed' though the glossary note calls it a gift; translated as written.

en: "No, that is its true form.{w}At last, the sword itself has acknowledged you too."{w}
note: [JP]: 'the sword too' (as well as the people around him).

en: "Board Chair, are you all right?"{w}
"Ah, never mind me...{w}What about the Principal? Is he safe?"{w}{p}"It looked as though he was surrounded by Death Tentacles and blown up spectacularly by their spells..."{w}
note: Principal is male (lead convention).

en: "Oh, right, the Principal.{w}Principal, are you all right!!"{w}
"*sizzle*... *smolder*..."{w}
note: [JP] = smoking/smoldering sound effect.

en: "He's fine!"{w}
note: Deadpan comic beat: Soara reports to the Board Chair.

en: "I see.{w}Then go and fetch the School Nurse.{w}Those youngsters over there could use some treatment as well."{w}
note: [JP] = Mirco's group; 'youngsters' keeps it gender-neutral.

en: "Ahwoooh! Nnnohhh-heyyy!!"{w}
note: Nonverbal cries of the School Nurse; [JP] read as a drawn-out 'hey'.

en: Once the treatment was done, the School Nurse left.{w}
"Soara, I've caused you a lot of trouble. That was unlike me...{w}Research truly must be done with people one can trust."{w}
"I was mistaken, too.{w}True peace for the land...{w}I didn't know what you had in mind, Board Chair... I'm sorry."{w}
